meta.subject: English
meta.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision
meta.title: Word Work: Sorting Diction in the Model

questions.prompt: Model sentence: The theater had broken seats, peeling paint, and a leaking roof. Which adjective best describes the building's poor condition?
questions.explanation: Dilapidated describes a building that has fallen into poor condition through neglect or age.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, "After the researchers uploaded the survey, they compared the responses with the previous year's data." What does the pronoun "they" refer to?
questions.explanation: The plural pronoun they refers to the researchers, who performed both actions in the model.
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: The passage portrays an old oak with a ______ crop of acorns, providing enough food for several animals through winter. Which adjective most precisely means present in large quantity?
questions.explanation: Abundant means present in large quantity, matching the plentiful supply of acorns in the passage.

questions.prompt: A model describes an office tool: “The employee used a device to make a photocopy of the report.” Which word is the precise name for that device?
questions.explanation: A copier is specifically designed to make photocopies, so it precisely names the device described.
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: The account describes a witness who does not hide or soften any part of a description of a disagreement. Which adjective most precisely describes that quality?
questions.explanation: Candid means truthful and direct in expression, matching an account that does not hide or soften details.

questions.prompt: In a formal report, the witness said that she had seen the event. Which verb best replaces said with formal, neutral diction?
questions.explanation: Stated is a formal, neutral way to report what someone said without adding emotional tone.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, “At noon, the technicians checked the equipment beside the storage room.” Which phrase states when the technicians checked the equipment?
questions.explanation: At noon is the prepositional phrase that identifies the time of the inspection.
questions.skill: Sorting a model sentence by function
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: An archive report shows an archivist checking every date against the original ledger in a careful sequence. Which adverb best describes this orderly, step-by-step method?
questions.explanation: Systematically means in an organized, step-by-step manner, which matches the archivist's careful sequence of checking dates.

questions.prompt: A model sentence says, “The hikers continued along the narrow mountain trail at a steady pace.” Which word sharpens the sentence without changing its meaning?
questions.explanation: Hiked conveys that the people were traveling on foot along a trail.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, “The technician calibrated the instrument before recording the measurements.” Which term most precisely names the process of checking or correcting the instrument's accuracy?
questions.explanation: Calibration is the process of checking and correcting a measuring instrument's accuracy.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, "The diver's hand sank deeply into the soft, springy sea sponge." Which adjective most precisely describes the sponge's texture?
questions.explanation: Spongy means soft and yielding when pressed, which matches the texture described in the model.
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: The model calls the insect extremely small. Which adjective is the most precise synonym for extremely small?
questions.explanation: Minuscule means extremely small and therefore matches the model's description precisely.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads: The teacher gave each student a short quiz at the start of class. Which verb most precisely replaces gave in a formal description of the lesson?
questions.explanation: Administered means formally gave or carried out a quiz, such as a test or assessment.

questions.prompt: A narrow trail ran along the high line of land where two mountain slopes met. Which landform does this description name?
questions.explanation: A ridge is the high line of land where two slopes meet.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: “The revised proposal differs ___ the original plan.”
questions.explanation: The standard construction is “differ from,” meaning to be unlike something used for comparison.

questions.prompt: The model sentence states that the exhibition will begin at noon in the main hall. Which verb is the most formal synonym for begin in this sentence?
questions.explanation: Commence is a formal verb meaning to begin, so it matches both the meaning and the formal register.

questions.prompt: A librarian tells a student, “You may ______ this book for two weeks, but you must not ______ it to anyone else.”
questions.explanation: Borrow means taking a book temporarily, while lend means allowing someone else to take it temporarily.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, "The steam from the kettle was hot enough to burn the cook's fingertips." Which word most precisely describes the steam's heat?
questions.explanation: Scalding means extremely hot and capable of injuring skin, which matches the model's description.
questions.skill: Choosing a word by degree of intensity
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: In the model sentence “The river bank was covered with smooth stones,” which definition gives the word’s meaning in that sentence?
choices: a side or slope of land beside water
a long seat for several people
the upper deck of a ship
questions.explanation: In this context, bank means the side or slope of land beside a river.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, “The volunteers passed the dry soil through a mesh screen to separate tiny seeds from the dirt.” Which verb most precisely describes that action?
questions.explanation: Sifting means passing loose material through a screen to separate particles of different sizes.
questions.skill: Selecting a precise verb from context

questions.prompt: A food review describes the sauce as having a sharp, pungent, and unpleasant taste. Which adjective means irritating or pungent to the taste?
questions.explanation: Acrid means sharp, pungent, or irritating to the senses, especially to the taste.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads: The heavy rain cracked several roof tiles, and water later leaked into the classroom. Which verb most precisely describes what the rain did to the roof?
questions.explanation: Damaged precisely describes physical harm to an object without claiming that the object was completely destroyed.
questions.skill: Replacing a vague verb with a precise verb

questions.prompt: The draft states, “After revision, the editor found ______ errors in the report.” Which word is correct in this sentence?
questions.explanation: Fewer is used with countable plural nouns such as errors, while less is used with uncountable nouns.

questions.prompt: A model announcement says, "The school will determine the schedule next week." Which revision is most appropriate for a formal school announcement?
choices: The school will probably decide the schedule next week.
The school will quickly choose the schedule next week.
The school will kind of settle the schedule at some point.
The school will determine the schedule next week.
questions.explanation: Determine is a formal, neutral verb that accurately states how the school will establish the schedule.
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads, “The reporter asked the witness a lot of questions after the interview began.” Which revision preserves the facts while using more precise wording?
choices: The reporter questioned the witness at length after the interview began.
The reporter ignored the witness after the interview began.
The reporter praised the witness after the interview began.
The reporter argued with the witness after the interview began.
questions.explanation: Questioned the witness at length precisely conveys that the reporter asked many questions after the interview began.
questions.skill: Replacing vague phrasing with precise verbs
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: A weather report explains that a meteorologist uses a small instrument to measure atmospheric pressure. Which device does the meteorologist use?
questions.explanation: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.prompt: A worksheet gives this model: “The workshop lasted three hours.” Which replacement phrase should the draft “The workshop lasted a long time” use to match the model exactly?
questions.explanation: The model gives the duration as three hours, so “for three hours” matches it exactly.
questions.skill: Converting a vague phrase into an exact detail

questions.prompt: The model says the child's patient waiting helped the team finish the difficult puzzle. Which noun names the quality of calmly enduring a delay?
questions.explanation: Patience is the quality of waiting calmly and enduring difficulty without becoming upset.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads: Several months of little or no rain left the farms without enough water. Which word names the prolonged dry weather condition?
questions.explanation: A drought is an extended period of abnormally dry weather marked by a serious lack of water.
questions.skill: Identifying a precise noun for a condition

questions.prompt: A model study states that researchers found a correlation between runoff and flooding, but more research is needed to establish causation. Which sentence preserves the model’s limits on certainty?
choices: Runoff causes flooding, as the study has conclusively shown.
Runoff appears related to flooding, but the cause is not yet established.
Runoff has no measurable relationship with flooding.
Runoff is the only proven cause of flooding.
questions.explanation: Appears related to flooding conveys the observed correlation without claiming that runoff has been proved to cause flooding.

questions.prompt: A draft sentence says, “The volunteers moved supplies across the courtyard with great effort.” Which adverb most precisely describes action performed with strenuous effort?
questions.explanation: Laboriously means with strenuous effort, matching the action described in the sentence.

questions.prompt: A catalog records this model: The library contains 8,412 volumes. Which phrase most precisely matches the model when revising the draft sentence, "The library contains thousands of books"?
questions.explanation: The phrase 8,412 volumes preserves both the exact quantity and the catalog's precise term.
questions.skill: Replacing vague quantity with exact detail
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: In the sample, the review panel will ______ its decision until the following week. Which word most precisely means to move something to a later time?
questions.explanation: Defer means to postpone something to a later time, matching the panel’s decision to wait until the following week.

questions.prompt: A model sentence says, “The test solution changed from colorless to pale yellow.” Which option preserves the model’s stated hue and shade?
questions.explanation: Turned pale yellow retains both the yellow color and the light shade named in the model.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads: The lighthouse stood so high above the rocky coast that its beam reached far out to sea. Which adjective most precisely describes the lighthouse's height?
questions.explanation: Towering means extremely high and rising prominently above the surrounding area.
questions.skill: Choosing an adjective for precise description

questions.prompt: Model sentence: A thin white coating of ice covered the garden plants before sunrise. Which term identifies the coating on the plants?
questions.explanation: Frost is a thin layer of ice that forms on plants and other surfaces in cold conditions.

questions.prompt: A formal report should preserve this model: The kid really wanted the new game, so he asked his parents for it. Which revision is most appropriate for a formal report while preserving the meaning?
choices: The child strongly desired the new game and requested it from his parents.
The child wanted the new game, so his parents gave it to him.
The child purchased the new game after receiving his parents' approval.
The child did not want the new game and refused his parents' request.
questions.explanation: The revision uses formal diction such as desired and requested while preserving the facts that the child wanted the game and asked the parents for it.

questions.prompt: Model sentence: Although the plan sounded clever, the team did not trust the inventor's motives. Which adjective carries the suspicious sense of clever?
questions.explanation: Cunning suggests clever behavior intended to deceive, which explains the team's distrust.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads: The defendant avoided giving a direct answer to the lawyer's question. Which adjective most precisely describes the defendant's response?
questions.explanation: Evasive describes a response that avoids giving a direct or clear answer.

questions.prompt: A model records, “The temperature fell from 20 degrees Celsius to 10 degrees Celsius.” Which sentence states the temperature change most precisely?
choices: The temperature decreased by 10 degrees Celsius.
The temperature increased by 10 degrees Celsius.
The temperature decreased by 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
The temperature remained at 20 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: The temperature decreased by exactly 10 degrees Celsius because the final reading was 10 degrees lower than the initial reading.
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: During a foggy hike, the walkers can barely make out the trail ahead. Which adjective means difficult to see or identify?
questions.explanation: Indistinct means difficult to see or make out, matching the trail that the walkers can barely discern in the fog.

questions.prompt: Model sentence: The walkers went from one edge of the meadow to the other. Which verb best states the movement across the meadow?
questions.explanation: Crossed means moved from one edge or side to another, matching the walkers' movement across the meadow.

questions.prompt: A model sentence reads: The speaker's detailed argument was convincing enough to change the judges' minds. Which adjective means able to make someone accept an idea or belief?
questions.explanation: Compelling means able to persuade someone strongly through evidence, reasoning, or appeal.
questions.skill: Matching an adjective to its meaning

questions.prompt: Complete the description: “The error was hard to see because the printed line was very ______.”
questions.explanation: A faint line has low visibility, which explains why the error was difficult to see.

questions.prompt: A model reads, "The report's sections introduced each point, linked the evidence, and reached a clear conclusion." Which adjective most precisely describes the report's organization?
questions.explanation: Coherent describes ideas that are logically connected and arranged in a clear sequence.
questions.topic: Study a Model and Sort Its Parts - Diction and Precision

questions.prompt: A geology report explains that an excavation became damp when the digging reached the water table. What does the phrase reached the water table mean in this context?
choices: the deepest layer of solid bedrock
the surface runoff collected in the excavation
the main channel of a nearby stream
the underground level where the ground becomes saturated
questions.explanation: Reaching the water table means arriving at the underground level where the ground becomes saturated with water.

questions.prompt: The reference sentence describes an old gate whose hinges make a harsh scraping noise whenever it moves. Which adjective names this sound most precisely?
questions.explanation: Rasping means harsh and unpleasant to hear, so it precisely identifies the gate's scraping noise.

questions.prompt: A model dialogue reads, “No, that plan will never work,” the manager said sharply. Which verb captures the irritation in the manager’s reply?
questions.explanation: Retorted specifically describes a sharp, often angry reply, so it matches the manager's irritated tone.

questions.prompt: In the model, the weary workers dragged the heavy crate across the factory floor. Which verb most precisely shows that the crate was pulled along the ground?
questions.explanation: Dragged means pulled or moved along a surface, matching the action described in the model.

questions.prompt: A model lab report says, “The sample got warm very quickly.” Which revision is best suited to a scientific audience?
choices: The sample experienced a rapid thermal change.
The sample's heat content rose very quickly.
The temperature of the sample went up fast.
questions.explanation: The sample's temperature increased rapidly names the measured quantity and rate in standard scientific language.

feedback.correct: Sharp choice — that word does real work.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Reread the choices and ask which one carries the exact meaning and tone.
feedback.win: Every pair matched — your word choices are as precise as the model's.
feedback.lose: The cards stayed stubborn today, but the words will come around next time.

rejected.prompt: A model sentence reads, “The team’s totally, completely unexpected victory surprised everyone.” Which revision keeps the meaning but uses the most precise, economical wording?
choices: The team’s unexpected victory surprised everyone.
The team’s very, rather unexpected victory surprised everyone.
The team’s totally and absolutely unexpected victory amazed everyone.
The team’s unexpected and nearly impossible victory astonished everyone.
rejected.explanation: The original intensifiers add emphasis without clearer information, so unexpected alone communicates the result precisely and concisely.

rejected.prompt: A museum label describes “a small, round metal disk used as money.” Which noun names the object most precisely?
rejected.explanation: A coin is a small, round piece of metal used as money.

rejected.prompt: When editing for a formal report, which sentence most precisely preserves the meaning of “The team needs more time to finish the task”?
choices: The team has enough time to complete the task.
The team wants more time to start the task.
